* * *

A journalist returns to the small town she left years ago to report on two unsolved crimes, and is pulled back into the family history she spent half her life escaping. Staying in her mother's grand Victorian house for the first time in eight years, she finds herself identifying with the victims a little too closely, and the town's polite surface starts to crack. A tense, unsettling debut about memory, guilt and the stories families tell to protect themselves. ...more
